main_text.l: præter illa centum, quibus omnia suppofui[?] contineri, dari aliud quidpiam, à quo sint illa centum, hoc est, numero illo centenario omnes res quæ jam sunt nequaquam contineri, quod est contra hypothesin.

Datur igitur necessario ens aliquod quod est à se, hoc est, datur Deus. Dei enim attributa, perfectionesque divinas illi rei quæ suam existentiam sibi debet necessario competere, facile est demonstratu.

page.notes: The final letter of "suppofui" is faint and uncertain; read as "ui" with a doubtful final stroke. The numeral LXXII is set in spaced capitals and is treated as a numbered thesis, not a heading. Hyphenated line breaks are kept as printed ("om-nes", "per-fectionesque", "existen-tiam"). The left edge shows fragments of the facing page's margin notes; these are not part of this page and were left out.
